description: List the frame profiles (mouldings) ArtVinci can frame an artwork with, including each profile's per-linear-meter rate.
name: framing_list-frame-profiles

description.description: Longer description of the profile, when available.

galleryUrl.description: URL to a gallery page for this profile, when available.

id.description: Stable identifier for this frame profile.

imageUrl.description: URL to a product image for this profile, when available.

name.description: Display name of the frame profile.

pricePerLinearMeterRon.description: Rate, in RON per linear meter of this profile, when priced.

thicknessMm.description: Profile thickness, in millimeters, when specified.

widthMm.description: Profile width, in millimeters, when specified.
